engine_summary_note: ALL THREE calls returned an engine summary paragraph. NONE WAS USED FOR ANY PURPOSE. Each refusal is itemised in 'engine_syntheses_refused' so a successor can see exactly what was refused rather than inferring it from silence.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine paragraph's account of what arbitral tribunals 'must determine' about covered investors and covered investments, and its statement of the 'two basic requirements to arbitrate a dispute' (subject-matter jurisdiction from a covered investment under the IIA; personal jurisdiction from investor nationality).
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: Doctrinal synthesis from a search engine with no body opened and no locator. It states the content of a class of treaty provisions this seat has not read. Refused.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine paragraph's enumeration of what investment treaties 'typically include' in the definition of an expropriable investment ('enterprises, shares, stock, construction contracts, licenses, authorizations, and permits').
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: An engine's composed generalisation about treaty text. It is also the precise proposition a geographical-indication query exists to test - whether a GI falls inside such an enumeration - so importing it would settle by repetition the question the call was fired to ask. Refused twice over.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine's closing characterisation that the results 'do not specifically address geographical indications as covered investments'.
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: An engine's characterisation of its own result set is not an observation. What IS recorded below is this seat's own observation of the rows: 0 of 10 returned titles carries the string 'geographical indication'. That is a fact about ten titles, not a fact about the world.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine paragraph's account of the ICSID Convention Article 25 'dual test' / 'double-barrelled test', and its statement that ICSID tribunals 'have the authority to assess whether a specific transaction qualifies as an investment under the ICSID Convention independently of the definition in a BIT'.
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: It describes ICSID Convention Article 25's operation by content from an engine paragraph, with no body opened. This is the same class of refusal as the standing prohibition on describing NAFTA Article 1110's or Article 1105's internal structure, and this seat applies it to Article 25 by parity. Refused.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine paragraph's statement that 'tribunals have been unwilling to widen the application of MFN clauses to import a more favorable definition of investment from other treaties'.
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: An unattributed generalisation over unnamed tribunal holdings. A holding may enter only from a primary source. Refused.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine paragraph's account of what data exclusivity is and does ('a limited duration of time during which only the owner or generator of preclinical and clinical trial data can use it for purposes of marketing authorization'), and its account of TRIPS-Plus conditions in US and EU free trade agreements.
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: This sits directly on the project's central sub-question (clinical-trial data as a protected investment), which is where an unsourced synthesis does the most damage. No body was opened. Refused - and refused the more firmly BECAUSE it is convenient.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine paragraph's statement that 'investment treaties provide IP owners with direct access to investor-state arbitration' and its enumeration of substantive protections (FET, national and MFN treatment, protection against unlawful expropriation).
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: Treatise-level synthesis from an engine; no locator, no body. It is also a restatement of the project's own research premise and would read as corroboration of that premise while being nothing of the kind.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine's closing characterisation that the results 'do not contain specific information about investment treaty arbitration tribunal cases that have addressed expropriation claims related to data exclusivity on clinical trial data'.
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: Same ground as the S1 closing characterisation. The recorded observation is this seat's own: 0 of 9 returned titles names an investor-State case or tribunal.

calls_returned_unspent.would_have_spent: tobacco (Ring 1, never fired in either population), with plain packaging
calls_returned_unspent.not_fired_because: REFUSED ON THE MERITS, not deferred. 'tobacco' is never-fired because the subject it names is the subject of a seed award this project has already extracted in full: working/one-pagers/philip-morris-v-australia.md is tracked at HEAD, 8,832 bytes, and the operator's read of that award is the project's Philip Morris material. Yesterday's method finding (2026-09-27 S1) established that a seed-shaped retrieval key collapses the result set onto the seed; 'tobacco' + 'plain packaging' is a seed-shaped key by SUBJECT rather than by NAME and the same collapse is predicted. Spending a call to re-retrieve the case whose one-pager is already in the repository is the relevance inflation council_calibration.md item 4 forbids. THIS IS A NEVER-FIRED DESIGNATOR THAT WAS CORRECTLY IGNORED.

calls_returned_unspent.would_have_spent: one of trade mark / ipr / orphan drug / market exclusivity / drug
calls_returned_unspent.not_fired_because: ALL FIVE REFUSED ON THE MERITS, each for its own reason, and the reasons are different kinds. (i) 'trade mark' is the Commonwealth ORTHOGRAPHY of 'trademark', which has fired 4 times on the census; search engines fold the two, so the designator is a spelling sentinel and not a concept. The honest counter-argument - that Philip Morris v Australia is an Australian matter whose native sources use the Commonwealth spelling - is recorded and is not strong enough to buy a call, because the Australian matter is the one already extracted. (ii) 'ipr' collides head-on with 'inter partes review', a US patent-office procedure with a far larger corpus; firing it buys noise with a named mechanism. (iii) 'orphan drug' names a narrow EU/US exclusivity regime with no ISDS carrier anywhere in this repository. (iv) 'market exclusivity' is subsumed by 'data exclusivity', which fired today inside S3. (v) 'drug' is a bare noun subsumed by 'pharmaceutic' (fired 2026-09-24) and by every sharper term in the ring. FIVE NEVER-FIRED DESIGNATORS THAT WERE CORRECTLY IGNORED.

why_the_never_fired_set_is_two_different: THE DAY'S ANSWER TO THE CHAIRMAN'S QUESTION. The never-fired Ring-1 set is not one object. (a) COVERAGE HOLES WITH A MECHANISM - a designator names a concept the fired designators do NOT retrieve. Exactly two of the ten qualify: 'geographical indication' (a distinct IP right, verbatim in the research question, no synonym among the fired seven) and 'know-how' (the treaty-text synonym for the project's central intangible, which a 'trade secret' query does not reach). 'marketing authoris/z' is a third, weaker case: it names the measure-side instrument rather than a distinct right. All three were fired. (b) SENTINELS CORRECTLY IGNORED - a designator is never-fired because firing it would buy a spelling variant ('trade mark'), a homonym ('ipr'), a subsumed term ('drug', 'market exclusivity'), a subject already extracted in full ('tobacco'), or a regime with no carrier ('orphan drug'). Six of the ten. SO THE ANSWER IS: SEVEN OF THE TEN NEVER-FIRED RING-1 DESIGNATORS ARE SENTINELS, AND THE NEVER-FIRED COUNT WAS NEVER A COVERAGE DEFICIT OF TEN. A long designator list that mostly never fires is not evidence of neglect; on this ring it is mostly evidence of correct triage, and the 2026-09-27 warning that it 'gives false comfort' cuts BOTH ways - it also invites a false alarm.

verdict: THREE CALLS, THREE HONEST NULLS AT CASE LEVEL, AND THE SPEND BOUGHT A REAL ANSWER TO THE QUESTION IT WAS AUTHORISED FOR. The never-fired Ring-1 set is mostly sentinels, not a coverage hole: seven of ten are correctly ignored and are named with their reasons.
